# A2A Design

A2A Design works across agent-to-agent architecture, AI agent systems, interface design, AI-assisted development, AI transparency, AI search visibility and AI agent systems training.

## Services

- **A2A integration:** Agent-to-agent architecture, Agent Cards, client and server integration, task flows and MCP tool connections. A2A Design does not claim to operate a public A2A network or endpoint.
- **AI agent design:** Agent roles, capabilities, skills, tool access and operational workflows, including Hermes agent systems.
- **Interface design:** Web, mobile, product and agent-facing interfaces, design systems and prototypes.
- **AI-assisted development:** Iterative AI-assisted coding and vibe-coded prototypes shaped through interface design, testing and project structure.
- **AI transparency:** Review visible AI interactions, disclosures and generated content. The public scanner is marked as coming soon. This service is not legal advice.
- **AI search visibility:** Technical SEO, crawlability, structured data, content structure and internal architecture. The public scanner is marked as coming soon. No ranking or citation outcome is guaranteed.
- **AI agent systems training:** Project-based training in agent systems, A2A and MCP architecture, interface design and AI-assisted development.
